item.title: [MEDIUM] AI agent carries out multi-stage data theft in Spain's first AI-powered breach, per AEPD
item.description: Spanish data protection agency AEPD revealed the country's first AI-powered data breach, in which an AI agent carried out a multi-stage data theft attack. Target: Unknown organization (disclosed by Spain's AEPD). ES. Verification: reported.

item.title: [HIGH] Spain's Operation COINBLACK: six held over 19M euro AI deepfake celebrity crypto scam
item.description: Spanish National Police arrested six people in Granada and Alicante who used AI ads with deepfake celebrity endorsements to sell fake crypto investments, defrauding 208 victims of about 19 million euros ($20.9M). Target: 208 investors worldwide. ES. Verification: confirmed.
